reviews.text: Joey is a lifesaver I had recently foster failed and was at a loss and unsure if I could be a successful owner with a 70lb puppy. Joey gave me simple tips and coached me on confidence as a dog owner that has trickled down and given me a more confident dog, he even gets compliments in public now from strangers!  Definitely worth the time and investment. Starr Dog Behavior is given all my praise.

Joseph has gotten our young beagle to a great place in a very short time. We are still working with Starr behavior to keep this training on our part as well as Abby’s. . I am amazed by his control over this dog.

Connecting with Starr Dog Behavior and working with Joseph completely changed our day to day life & my relationship with my two dogs. It's so abundantly clear he is absolutely incredible at what he does. After a longgg search for a skilled, trustworthy trainer in the Dallas area, I couldn't have felt better leaving my two dogs for board and train. (coming from an overprotective dog mom this is saying a lot!)

I was blown away by the transformation in my previously untrained, VERY anxious, and stubborn dogs. My pups are so well behaved now and I am beyond grateful. In our initial consult, he maximized our time together with a very direct, clear approach ..which I certainly appreciated that there was no time wasted. This was money well spent for both the consult and the board & train. Joseph was super communicative and professional through the process.  I already know this investment has forever changed my dogs' lives and well-being & thankfully removed so much chaos from my household. My dogs and I are so much happier thanks to Starr Dog Behavior. Thank you so much!!!

Joseph is awesome! We knew we had a good dog, but he had no manners and was a bit difficult to deal with. The dog we got back is the same sweet boy, but he has manners and is much more relaxed and easy to deal with at home. I’d give him more stars if I could.

Not only trained my dog but taught us how important consistency was during and after training. He was easy to get a hold of for questions and helped us understand how to continuously train our pets now that they have graduated! Now that we are done he still is available, which is very rare. If you have a pet, and are in the area, call him up!
Joseph was able to get to the bottom of our pup issues and help us in one visit.  Looking forward to seeing our pups progress with his guidance!

He definitely knows what he is doing! I used to watch Cesar the dog whisperer growing up, and so I could see a lot of similarities.

Even after just the initial session, I was able to walk away with lots of instructions and knowledge that I’ve been implementing myself. This is not really stuff you can just get from the internet. It’s personalized - he did take time to try and get to know me and my dog.

I’ve had friends and family comment on the positive changes they see in my dog so far. Even strangers on the sidewalk commenting about how good of a walker she is.

As with any dog trainer I’d assume, you do have to be willing and open to work on yourself. He is brutally honest, but in a good way.

Absolutely thrilled from my time with Joseph. We did an in-house session, which was vital, as my dog had a terrible fear of the stairs and carrying up three flights was not going to cut it.

Since my dog was a shelter dog, there was a need to center the understanding that he wasn't in charge and Jospeh approached that with expertise. While explaining the process to me the whole time. For those who have seen the Dog Whisperer, there were moments where it felt like that. My dog was unsure but after some time and trust building he was ready to go.

The main thing I learned as an owner is to keep cool and confident. While I definitely have a long way to go, it was nice to have someone explain and follow up with practice on my own to ensure I understood the basics.

In only 2 hours, my pup was able to climb up the stairs and I haven't been having any stair fear since.

Highly recommend if you need a calm and collected trainer.

Joseph is truly the dog whisperer! My frenchie is like a new dog- he listens to commands and is so much more at ease. The board and train program really works. I’m so happy we trusted the process to train our dog with Starr Dog Behavior!
Start Dog Behavior is the best! Joseph was so kind and gentle. He really knows what he is doing. I highly recommend Starr Dog Behavior!!

My wife said that our dog "left a boy and came back a man." Joseph teaches how to provide clear leadership for your dog through calm interactions, established disciplined routines and limited excitement.  Our dog is high-energy, more dominant, and benefited from the training. We like the ability to bring the dog for boarding when we travel, which we leveraged shortly after taking him home.

can’t recommend Star dog behavior  enough! From the very first session, it was clear that they truly understand dog behavior and care deeply about helping both pets and owners succeed.
What I really appreciated was how patient and encouraging Joseph was not just with my dog, but with me too! They explained the “why” behind every technique and made the training process fun and positive. You can tell they genuinely love what they do.
Expert trainer

I cannot recommend Starr Dog Behavior enough! Joseph gave me excellent training tips for potty training my French Bulldog, and the results were nothing short of a miracle. Within just three days of following his advice, my pup was fully housebroken. Anyone who owns a Frenchie knows how stubborn they can be, so this was truly remarkable. Joseph’s approach was clear, practical, and easy to stick to, and it made the process stress-free for both me and my dog. I’m so grateful for his expertise and guidance—highly recommend him to anyone needing help with their dog’s behavior or training!

Starr dog behavior is the boss! Joseph took our two foundling dogs and made a tremendous difference.   We recommend his board-and-train program.  Joseph brought out their calmness, an ability to be followers, and be truly enjoyable for visitors as well as for us day and day out. They walk peaceably on a leash, are not reactive on walks, and they contentedly stay put when they sit or lie down to rest.  We, too, have become better dog owners benefitting from train-the-trainer.

Joseph was fantastic!  Really helped our rescue dog learn to behave around family and helped us learn how to handle a more difficult dog.  Our dog came back from training a completely different dog who is perfect for our family!  Highly recommended using Starr Dog Behavior!

Joseph very kindly boarded our Vizsla for us in June. He was great and easy to communicate with. He clearly loves dogs, and the expectations he sets for the dogs is amazing to see. A lovely mix of love and calm. Our pup seemed very happy and was very well cared for during her time at Starr Dog behaviour!

My elderly parents bought a new puppy from what we think was a puppy mill. She was super skittish and a barker, no manners, etc. We all agreed she needed training. A friend recommended Joseph and Starr Dog Behavior. Joseph has done an incredible job with their dog.  She has all of the confidence in the world and loves to go to her place. I cannot recommend Star Dog Behavior enough. His method is quite amazing.

I brought my dog , Juice to Joseph today after he became increasingly more reactive on his leash and around other dogs. The techniques Joseph taught me after an evaluation I will begin implementing immediately. Joseph seems very knowledgeable about what my dog needs, and what I need to do as an owner. After one session with Joseph I feel hopeful that he can fix both mine and Juice’s habits and make life significantly easier and more fulfilling for my dog. I plan to updated this post with progress as we begin seeing Joseph weekly for training.

My husband and I are in our 70’s and have had dogs together for over 50 years. We love them and the daily activities and enrichment they bring to our lives. After losing a precious Australian labradoodle a year ago, we decided it was time to get a new Australian labradoodle puppy.

All dogs, especially puppies, bring challenges. Our cute boy Jaxon is no exception. While we progressed quickly with our basic knowledge and experience in dog training, we are both at a phase in our lives that has us at home much more often than we were with our previous dogs. The constant contact created new issues for us with Jaxon. We both decided that outside expertise from a qualified trainer would enhance our control over his behavior, thereby making life easier for him and for us.

We contacted Joseph Starr after researching many Dallas area trainers. After the first in-home training visit, we were very impressed by Joseph’s gentle but firm command of Jaxon. We have homed in on a couple of key concepts we had not known to do during our many decades of having dogs. The first involves protecting our personal space from the dog and training him to realize he can enter that space only upon invitation. This helps with many issues we were having, such as jumping up on us and other people and being demanding of attention when we were busy and couldn’t or didn’t want to provide it. The second key concept focuses on how to help Jaxon control his arousal level, so he is calm when in the house and we are not in deliberate play mode with him.

Guided by Joseph, our work with Jaxon started paying off immediately. He is just shy of eight months old, so some days are better than others. And, we of course realize that to make this work, we need to be always communicating with him in a clear and consistent manner. It has been extremely helpful to have Joseph come to our home at spaced out intervals so we can practice in between, and Joseph can then fine tune the things we are attempting to do.

Joseph has a dog-whisperer level of command with Jaxon, but he is also very kind and loving with him. He communicates clearly and consistently with us, and in doing so he is helping us communicate clearly and consistently with Jaxon. His advice has produced visible results at each meeting, and our work in carrying that forward has made our Jaxon a true joy for us and our friends. This will be an ongoing process, for sure, but it is very capably guided in Joseph’s hands.

We feel fortunate to have found Joseph—our trusted trainer and our dog Charlie’s favorite place to board. Joseph’s thoughtful, intelligent approach has not only helped train our 2.5-year-old pup, but has taught us how to be better dog parents.

When we travel, it’s comforting to know that Charlie is in expert hands and playing with other trained dogs.  Joseph is an excellent communicator and keeps us updated when Charlie is with him.  Highest marks for Starr Dog Training.

We had a great experience with Joseph! We have a very energetic 1 y/o King Charles Cavalier who has a hard time following commands. We were amazed at how quickly Joseph was able to transform our dog to be calm and obedient. He was also super patient with us giving us lots of tips and advice that we could immediately put into practice. You can tell that Joseph knows dogs and is an expert at teaching them good behavior. I was amazed that he was able to seamlessly teach our dog to stay away from the cat food in a very short period of time which is something we had been struggling with for a while. He’s the real deal! I told him he’s like the dog whisperer and I truly meant it! Thanks Joseph!

We cannot speak highly enough of our experience with Starr Dog Behavior.  Frankie is an 8-month-old Bernedoodle.  She is a very energetic, affectionate, needy puppy.  Frankie has (had!) trouble calming herself down once she gets excited.  I don't know where we would be without Joseph and his unique "dog whisperer" talents.
Frankie now responds instinctively to the commands place, sit and down.   She walks without pulling her leash or chasing squirrels, which was incredibly challenging for her.  Most importantly,  she seems calmer and eases into different situations.
Joseph is passionate about this work. He trains dogs and owners, and it is vital to him that both are equipped with the tools to be successful. He communicates well and often while your dog is in his care.
Again,  we can't speak highly enough!!

My experience with Starr dog behavior training has been very good.  I have a 6-year-old Goldendoodle who is generally good dog but we needed to up his game as I was trying to make him a therapy dog at a Metroplex hospital for patients.  He would tug on leash, urinate throughout walks to mark his territory, and react unpredictably to other dogs.  They got to the point where my wife hated walking him in the neighborhood.  Joseph explained that Rocky was exhibiting alfa behavior rather than follower behavior.  He was very helpful in addressing these issues and particularly since the dog had 6 years of developing these bad habits.  When I picked him up I had additional training to continue making progress from the board and training and to teach my wife, children, and/or dog walker how he was to be treated and trained.  It is made a huge difference in the quality of our life.  We live in a high-rise and so the dog requires being walked at least twice a day.  Big dogs also usually require a fair amount of exercise in order to stay calm.  Rocky already got his good canine citizen award and is well on his way to becoming a therapy dog.

We had an incredible experience with Joseph at Starr Dog Behavior. Our 5-month-old Bernedoodle, Birdie, came home a completely transformed pup—in the best way possible!
Joseph has a gift. I swear, he can just look at a dog and they instantly understand what’s expected. He has such a calm, confident presence that naturally teaches both dogs and teaches us humans how to lead. From the moment Birdie was with him, we felt completely in the loop. His communication was excellent—we always knew what she was working on and how she was progressing.
One of my biggest worries was that Birdie would bolt out the door and take off. Joseph assured me that wouldn’t happen after training, and he was right. Now, she waits patiently at every threshold until she’s invited out. She has a solid understanding of her commands and is truly a dream to be around.  Want your dog to stay in place? Walk on a leash? Sit? Come? Chill on a patio? Well dream big because he can make it happen!
And the best part? Birdie came home calm. Yes—calm. Who can say that about a 5-month-old puppy, let alone a doodle? But with Joseph’s guidance, we now can!
If you're looking for a trainer who not only understands dogs but transforms them while empowering you as the owner, Joseph is the one. We can’t recommend him enough!

Seems to really know his stuff. Understands the dogs behavior and very quickly knows how to correct it. His approach to dog training seems very methodical and rooted in dog psychology.

Unfortunately, wouldn’t hire out of personal comfort and other concerns.
People should be mindful of their hands and personal space.

I came to Joseph for assistance with my 8 year old rescue dog, Honey, who had become more and more reactive over the last few years. The difference Joseph has made in 2 sessions is astounding. He has definitely changed our lives for the better and we are both grateful. I have learned a lot and I’m excited to continue working with Joseph. I would highly recommend his services!

We came to Joseph for boarding training with two dogs with very different eccentricities and needs and were incredibly pleased with his approach and results with both.

Joseph showed genuine interest in training our dogs and provided my wife and I the tools necessary to sustain the results. We’ve seen a huge change in the way the dogs interact with us and with others, our walks are more enjoyable, and most importantly the dogs seem to be calmer and happier.

Joseph was incredibly communicative throughout the process and still checks in with us to see how the dogs are doing. I would highly recommend Joseph and Starr Dog Behavior to any dog owner - you will not regret it!

As a three dog household with a toddler things are chaotic. When turned to Joseph when things were getting unmanageable. With Joseph’s guidance over the last few months, we have a calmer life. The dogs don’t rush to jump all over guests. Walking all three dogs (even with the stroller) is now possible without physical strain.
Joseph worked wonders with the pup that was board/train while we worked with an at home training with the other two. Joseph has been flexible with scheduling and worked to tailor training to our particular families needs and goals. We are certainly seeing the benefits.
Excellent

I cannot recommend Joseph at Starr Dog Behavior enough for anyone looking to improve their dog’s behavior or build a stronger bond with their furry friend.

Within just a few weeks, I noticed a dramatic improvement in Mazy’s behavior. Walks are now enjoyable instead of stressful, and he’s much calmer around other dogs. The change has been life-changing for both of us.

Great Trainer! He is great with my dog and with me. It’s not just about the dog but learning how to handle my dog properly. Thanks for training the both of us!! Highly recommend!
I was struggling with my dog’s behavior since he is aging and no matter what I tired it didn’t work! Joseph helped me get him back to routine and stay healthy. I am glad I found starr dog behavior!
Joseph worked very patiently with my senior female husky, helping to refresh and reinforce basic training and skills required for service animals. We are looking forward to working with him again.

Joseph is the best! Highly recommend! Unlike other similar businesses/individuals in the industry he only takes on however many dogs he knows he can fully give the attention to that they need. It’s evident it’s not about quantity for him …
